marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots near noon except
light in Prince Albert Sound. Wind increasing to southeast 25 near midnight
except southeast 15 in Prince Albert Sound. Wind increasing to southeast 30
early Sunday morning except southeast 15 in Prince Albert Sound. Temperatures near plus 3. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Sunday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre or less becoming 1 early this evening except less
than 1 in Prince Albert Sound. Seas building to 1 to 2 near midnight except 1 or
less in Prince Albert Sound. Seas becoming 2 early Sunday morning except 1 or
less in Prince Albert Sound.<br/>
